entities.summary: Bealach na Bà is an 18.1 km single-track Highland road crossing from Tornapress to Applecross, with steep hairpins and coastal views.
entities.description: Drive Bealach na Bà from the A896 at Tornapress over the Highland pass to the Applecross coast-road junction. Passing places serve the narrow road, and weather can cause restrictions; check conditions before setting out.
entities.whyWorthwhile: The Bealach na Bà road in Scotland combines a climb from sea level, tight mountain-road engineering and a reveal of the west coast in one compact crossing.

entities.summary: Techniquest in Cardiff is a hands-on science centre with many experiment stations for children to try.
entities.description: At Techniquest in Cardiff, children explore science by using hands-on experiment stations. The concentration of activities makes it a useful choice for families who prefer trying things to reading displays, especially with children aged 4–13. Check current opening and the requirements of particular activities before travelling.
entities.whyWorthwhile: Techniquest in Cardiff gives children aged roughly 4–13 plenty of practical experiments to explore, making science an active family outing.

entities.summary: Thorpe Park in Chertsey, Surrey, brings together major roller coasters including Hyperia and The Swarm for a thrill-focused day.
entities.description: Thorpe Park in Surrey is aimed at visitors who want a day of intense rides. Hyperia, The Swarm, Stealth, Nemesis Inferno and Saw are among its main draws. Queues and ride downtime can substantially reduce how much you experience, so choose the date carefully and book date-specific admission ahead. Expect extensive walking and standing, with height, restraint and medical rules for individual rides.
entities.whyWorthwhile: Thorpe Park in Surrey is worth choosing for its concentration of major roller coasters, provided you can accept the possibility of long queues and unavailable rides.

entities.summary: The Safari Lounge in Edinburgh’s Abbeyhill is a pub worth choosing for scratch-made tacos, changing specials and broad gluten-free choices.
entities.description: The Safari Lounge in Abbeyhill, Edinburgh, pairs an eccentric pub setting, including its Tiger Room, with a kitchen making tacos and changing globally inspired specials. Fish, pork and beef tacos are recurring draws, alongside local and real ales. Many dishes have gluten-free versions, but the kitchen is not dedicated gluten-free. Food service finishes before the bar, and the small kitchen can be slow when busy; check kitchen hours and consider reserving for a planned meal.
entities.whyWorthwhile: The Safari Lounge in Edinburgh’s Abbeyhill is a deliberate nearby choice for tacos and changing scratch-made specials, particularly if you want a broad gluten-free selection in a relaxed pub.
